text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is when the strong strive
to become
even stronger. Or so it should
be. However...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew! How was my time, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think I say "really good," but the shrill screaming nearby drowns out my words. And my thoughts. And everything else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think I say "really good," but the shrill screaming nearby drowns out my words. And my thoughts. And everything else.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji's been doing better and better ever
since she
started her classic year!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how lucky we are to have
summer camp
with her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Fuji Kiseki started her classic year,
her
popularity's shot up at the speed of
a peregrine
falcon tearing toward its
prey.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Sorry, there's usually a leader
who helps
keep them in check.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But, since there's no one else training
here
besides us, it should be fine for
them to watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our days at summer camp continue
amidst a
perpetual chorus of shrieking
fans...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All right, time for a break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Skitter, skitter, skitter.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji! I bought the magazine you're on
the cover
of! Your interview was
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan B
text_block_list.text:
What, no way! How'd you get a copy? It
was sold
out everywhere I went!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait until your senior year! I
literally live to
see your races, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um... Okay, dear ponies, why don't we
all take a
step back and calm down
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A hoard of Umamusume rush toward Fuji
Kiseki.
Things are getting dangerous, so
I open my
mouth to tell them to back
off, when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you lot! Fuji's tryin' to get ready for
a big
race! You're all out of hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon, the strong-willed dorm
leader of
Miho Dorm, comes stomping
up to us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And you, Fuji! Don't just let 'em walk all
over you!
You gotta tell 'em off when
they get too rowdy!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks Hishiama... And sorry. I
wasn't being
attentive enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dear ponies, I'm so happy you're having
fun, but I
have to focus on my training!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I think you've observed me enough. Can
you
promise to focus on your own
training now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good! I hope you're looking forward to
the best
entertainment you've ever seen
in your lives!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Swooon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the one hand, it's great how popular
she is.
On the other... it's a bit
frightening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believes in Fuji Kiseki right
now. They
believe without a doubt that
she can succeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My anxiety only worsens over time. And
then, one
evening...
choice_data_list: （プレッシャーになっていないといいが）
（プレッシャーになっていないといいけど）

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hey, fancy meeting you here.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You seem worried about something
lately, so...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that? There's something
glittering
behind you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ignores my bewildered reaction and
reaches
behind my ear...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! I never expected to find a
drink in such
a place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She produces a colorful drink from
seemingly
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Surprise! Are you thirsty?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've been looking so worried lately, I
wanted
to cheer you up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? You can talk to me if
you'd
like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should've known better than to try to
hide
anything from her. She's always
been so sharp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So many expectations are on her, from
the world
and her fellow racers. I tell her
I'm worried she's
working too hard
because of it.
choice_data_list: ……君が無理をしていないか心配で
……貴方が無理をしていないか心配で

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Is that what you've been fussing
about all
this time?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to worry about. On the
contrary,
I'm really happy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Plays and magic shows can only start
after you've
got everyone's attention,
you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She carries on, speaking as gently and
calmly as
she can.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I get so excited thinking about the sights
I can
show everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, while I appreciate that you're always
thinking
of me, there's no need for you
to fret.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, take any apologetic feelings you
may have
left and swallow them with
your drink.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Urged by her soft smile, I gulp down the
drink she
gave me, and a refreshing
sweetness fills my
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My worries haven't magically
disappeared by any
means, but if I keep
stressing out over Fuji Kiseki,
she'll end
up fussing over me instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's as if the sweet drink was enough to
bolster my
confidence, and some of my
worries fade away
like wisps of smoke.
choice_data_list: （なら、信じてしっかり支えよう）

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There. You always look better when you
smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. I'd better get going. There's a
dorm leader
meeting at six.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We'll be talking about our schedules, so
I was
hoping you could join us today...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hm, but there's not much time before
the meeting
starts. Okay, time for one of
my secret tricks!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to carry you to our meeting
spot!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Or we could use a shortcut, but it has a
pretty
steep hill so I won't be able to
carry you up it.
What'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Okay, will do! Hold on tight!
choice_data_list: 近道の急坂を通って帰る

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just tell me if you start getting scared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Fuji Kiseki's great efforts, we
manage
to make it to the meeting on
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right. Let's do our best then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we begin climbing Fuji Kiseki's
"steep
hill." Except it's not a hill—it's
practically a cliff.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Give me your hand and watch where you
put your
feet!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look! See that light? That means we're
almost
there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki pulls me up, and we somehow
make it
in time!
